title: An order summary that adapts
task: Make `OrderSummary` describe the cart. With no items it shows only "Your cart is empty." Otherwise it shows the item count ("1 item", "3 items") and the total, plus a "Free shipping" note when the total is 50 or more.
hints:
When the whole output changes, return early: `if (itemCount === 0) { return

…

; }`.
Look closely at `{itemCount && …}`. When `itemCount` is `0`, the expression evaluates to `0`, and React renders that number.

Use a ternary for the word, `itemCount === 1 ? "item" : "items"`, and a boolean on the left of `&&` for the note: `{total >= 50 &&

Free shipping

}`.
